{"thought": "I sincerely apologize for the persistent JSON formatting issues. I am reviewing my process to ensure this does not happen again.

I have prepared the test case based on the issue description. The test aims to demonstrate the `repr` mismatch for `OutOfOrderTableProxy`. I will now run this test to confirm it fails as described in the issue.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import tomlkit

def test_repro_issue_439():
    toml_content = """
a.b.c = "d"
a.b.e = "f"
"""
    
    a = tomlkit.parse(toml_content)
    value = a["a"]
    expected = {"b": {"c": "d", "e": "f"}}

    # This assertion should pass, showing that the equality check works
    assert value == expected

    # This assertion should fail due to the bug
    assert repr(value) == repr(expected)
"}}
